name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=ui_menu party screen). Name accurately reflects the function's purpose: open/display the full-screen 'army status' party overview (chapter/turn/gold/per-team alive counts/roster). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Confirmed by sole caller fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch which invokes it when the menu cursor == 0 (STATUS option).
purpose: Open and run the full-screen 'army status' party overview: slide it in, animate/redraw while waiting for a keypress, then slide it back out and restore the underlying battle screen.
logic_summary: Allocates two 64000-byte (320x200 mode-13h) workspaces: snapshot_buf (zeroed) and panel_buf. Recomposites the battle tile map + character overlay into large_game_state_buffer+0x8088 and blits that 312x192 region into snapshot_buf+0x504 (the 0xA0000 mirror minus the mode-13h header), then renders the static overview content (chapter/turn/gold/roster) into panel_buf at stride 320. Intro: 12-frame slide-in (frame 0..11); each frame restores the backdrop (snapshot_buf -> large_game_state_buffer), advances right/top/bottom-main/bottom-small panel slide steps, then pushes the composite to VGA (0xA0000). Wait loop: spins until the keyboard buffer is non-empty; while waiting, if the BIOS tick word @ 0x46C (read MOVSX word->int) differs from last_tick it ticks the chapter palette + palette-cycle animation, recomposites the battle scene, re-renders the overview content into large_game_state_buffer+0x7964 (stride 456) and blits it to 0xA0504. Drains the keyboard buffer, runs the outro (12-frame slide-out, frame 11..0, mirror of intro using the LEFT main-panel step), restores the battle screen (snapshot_buf -> 0xA0000), frees both workspaces, and drains the keyboard buffer again. Faithful binary artifact: last_tick is read by the wait-loop gate but never written (in the binary it is the caller's leftover EBP, uninitialized), so the redraw fires nearly every iteration. The binary's trailing JMP 0x10C49 is this function's own epilogue (ADD ESP,4 / POP EDI/ESI/EBX / RET), tail-merged with two siblings; a plain return regenerates it.

returns.semantics: No return value; returns to caller after the player presses a key and the screen slides out.

notes: Disassembly cross-check confirmed: 2 buffers malloc(0xFA00)=64000 (snapshot_buf in EBX, panel_buf in ESI), both freed (0x1b402, 0x1b40b); wait-loop gate at 0x1b2fb is MOVSX EAX, word ptr [0x46C] then CMP EAX,EBP (EBP = uninitialized last_tick), faithfully modeled by source as (int32)(int16)BIOS_TICK_WORD != last_tick; trailing JMP 0x10C49 is the shared tail epilogue. Source comment and Ghidra plate are mutually consistent and accurate; no edits needed to either. No symbol renamed (none required). Stage-2 rename not applicable.
